hero.text: A hand-built electric hypercar with nothing to prove.

specs.title:
Nocturne
N1
specs.text: A carbon shell, three motors and a cabin that wraps around you.

cards.title: Three-motor drive
cards.text: One motor up front and two at the rear, with torque shared to every wheel in milliseconds.

cards.title: Solid-state pack
cards.text: Dense cells sit flat in the floor and keep the centre of gravity right down.

cards.title: Active air
cards.text: The wing lifts and the floor seals as the speed climbs, so it stays planted.

cards.title: Two seats, one purpose
cards.text: Room for two and a weekend away, wrapped in a single carbon shell.

cards.title: Fast charging
cards.text: Ten to eighty percent in twenty minutes on any 350 kW charger.

cards.title: Eight-year cover
cards.text: Battery, motors and body, whoever is behind the wheel.
